question: Should this WhatsApp quote fix wait for live WhatsApp Desktop proof, or may a maintainer override based on the source-level fix, Baileys contract test, and hosted CI?
rationale: The changed behavior is visible only in a real WhatsApp Desktop swipe-reply flow, and the PR discussion says that proof was not available from the contributor.

options.title: Require live Desktop proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted WhatsApp Desktop recording or equivalent live output shows the bot-authored reply bubble after the fix.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A responsible owner may explicitly accept the source/CI/Baileys proof and own the remaining live-rendering uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require live Desktop proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted WhatsApp Desktop recording or equivalent live output shows the bot-authored reply bubble after the fix.
